dedupe_keys.name: dataset of detailed hydrogeological investigation for water supply in tengri industrial park alxa left banner inner mongolia autonomous region

description: Dataset of Detailed Hydrogeological Investigation for Water Supply in Tengri Industrial Park, Alxa Left Banner, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is a data set described in the paper "Dataset of Detailed Hydrogeological Investigation for Water Supply in Tengri Industrial Park, Alxa Left Banner, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2017), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). This dataset is provided by the ‘Detailed prospecting of water supply hydrogeology in Alashan League in Inner Mongolia’ from the Geological Survey Institute of Inner Mongolia. It contains data of water pumping tests (12 drilling points), ground water chemical (40 water samples), rock sample tests (102 rock samples) and simultaneous measurement of groundwater level (35 test points). Coverage: Tengri Industrial Park, Alxa Left Banner, Inner Mongolia, China. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support water supply planning for an industrial park. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
